fields.title: Unlocking Surya Ghar Subsidies: A Complete Guide for Homeowners
fields.content: Under the national PM-Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, homeowners can avail of substantial central subsidies for installing rooftop solar. For up to 2KW systems, the subsidy covers up to 60% of the cost, while systems between 2KW and 3KW receive 40% subsidy support. This article walks you through the step-by-step application workflow, MNRE approved panel specifications, and how local installers in Surat configure these connections.
fields.excerpt: A detailed step-by-step breakdown of India's PM-Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana rooftop solar subsidies.

fields.title: Why Monoperc Half-Cut Cells are Dominating Rooftop Installations
fields.content: Traditional polycrystalline solar cells are quickly becoming a thing of the past. Monocrystalline Perc half-cut solar panels have set new industry standards by increasing efficiency up to 23%. By split-design manufacturing, half-cut panels reduce internal resistive loss, resulting in better heat tolerance and superior power generation under shaded conditions. Learn why upgrading to Mahi Monoperc panels is the smartest investment for your clean energy setup.
fields.excerpt: Discover the technical engineering advantages of monocrystalline half-cell PV panels over traditional solar panels.
